result.document_summary: A mid-document excerpt of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3, Article 3 (casino party licensing and firearm dealer permits), retrieved from a page whose URL points to the algorithmic rent-price-fixing section but whose text does not include it.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code §§ 33.4106-33.4212 (casino party licenses and Firearm Dealer permits). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting, so no rules were extracted. The source URL refers to § 98.1103 (use and sale of algorithmic devices prohibited), but that text does not appear in this part and no rule is extracted from the URL alone.
